functional.reason: Functional results could not be produced without altering the hand-written evals/evals.json. The DevOpsAgentSDKCLI functional runner validates evals.json against its own Draft-7 schema and fails closed before any DevOps Agent space is provisioned. Running `devops-agent skill-eval functional skills/postgresql-dba --aws-profile cli-user --iterations 1` returned: `Error: evals.json schema validation failed (1 error): (root): [ ... ] is not of type 'object'`. The runner requires evals.json to be a JSON object with required keys `skill_name` and `evals`, where each eval also carries `task_type` (chat|investigation) and `should_trigger`. This skill's hand-written evals.json is instead a top-level JSON array in the Agent Skills specification shape (id/prompt/expected_output/files/assertions), which the structure and best-practices evaluators accept but the functional runner does not. Producing functional results would require rewriting the hand-authored evals.json into the functional runner's schema (changing assertion semantics from the `contains '...'`/`matches regex` string DSL to task_type/should_trigger evals with llm/regex assertions) and then provisioning a live with_skill/without_skill DevOps Agent space. A maintainer should author a functional-schema evals.json and run the functional comparison on a host with DevOps Agent space access, then commit evals/functional/v<N>/ and remove this exemption. Structure (evals/structure/, score 100% PASSED) and best-practices (evals/best-practices/v1/, produced) were run and committed.
